app.name: WiiCam
app.long_description:
0.2.22 local test: the microphone test mode and developer diagnostics are removed, and the SD card log is short. Everything else works as in 0.2.21. Choose Video + audio first after launching.
Take photos with a USB camera or record silent MJPEG video.
Choose 320 x 240 or 640 x 480, set a photo timer, or refresh the camera source using the menu.
Requires IOS58 and an SD card to save.
Supports the Ubisoft Hercules WC04 camera and selected UVC 1.0 MJPEG cameras.
Video is limited to 60 seconds or 128 MiB.
